SQLite permits only one simultaneous write transaction, and BEGIN IMMEDIATE starts a write transaction immediately or can fail with SQLITE_BUSY if another connection already has an active write transaction.
SQLite trigger execution of RAISE(ABORT, message) terminates the current query and returns SQLITE_CONSTRAINT with the supplied message.
Python 3.12's hashlib provides sha256, whose hexdigest method returns a hexadecimal representation of the digest.
